These conditions favor daytime maxima near 23–24 °C on August 12, aligning with the market’s leading 24 °C outcome at 44.5 % implied probability. August climatology typically sees highs of 23–25 °C in the subtropical winter regime, but the recent frontal cooling and limited solar heating from lingering cloud cover have kept probabilities for 25 °C or higher below 30 %. Updated model runs through the day will refine the exact peak before resolution.
